scope: Source-only iOS owner wake audit; no timing, battery attribution or wait-policy change
realWakeForRendering: Worker renderer barriers schedule main-queue work with dispatch_sync_f; actual drain occurs in that scheduled owner task. Plain command append intentionally batches.
pollDependentWork: SDL UIKit has no native WaitEventTimeout/SendWakeupEvent backend
MFI controller axes and buttons are sampled by backend update polling
SDL event queue consumption, gesture pulse deadlines, worker failure mailbox and completion checks need outer polls
snapshotCacheLimit: The app four-ms controller snapshot cache does not throttle the earlier SDL pump/joystick backend update.
limits: Configured maximum wait does not measure actual timeout count, wakeup rate or CPU cost.
No physical foreground-pump readings were provided; build23 predates the added foreground-pump diagnostic field.
No claim that polling causes the observed battery drain, and no justification for indefinite/longer blocking.
nextMeasurement: Count CFRunLoop return reasons and actual wait elapsed time
